admission.justification: Reading the flat subprocess payload together with individual bodies would allocate a second complete transport copy on a common path.

applicability: Binary native Git batch blob reads using the validated frame reader.
conditions: The private spool carries subprocess output directly.
Matching object identity, blob type, size, delimiters and input exhaustion are required for an accepted batch.
exclusions: The individually requested blob bodies may remain resident while the caller consumes them.
Single-object Explainer and grade reads use their own frame contracts.

evidence: The blob-spool test and bug-r18-item-2-ordinary-results.md, Git file and shared-memory measurements.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: Native Git blob reads consume validated object frames from a private spool without allocating an aggregate in-memory subprocess reply.
